description: Remove test-only server production contracts and replace forced AgentSession persistence with deterministic test-host observation.

tasks.title: Remove grain lifecycle and identity test controls
tasks.description: Remove forced-deactivation operations from the six production grain contracts and implementations, and replace their specification callers with one shared `IManagementGrain.ForceActivationCollection` helper. Remove the Agent, Epic, Issue, and Workflow grain key overrides, migrating identity-dependent tests to known keys on real InProcessTestCluster activations or to narrower non-grain collaborators.
acceptanceCriteria: IIssueGrain, IIssueRepositoryCoordinatorGrain, IAgentSessionGrain, IWorkflowGrain, IRunnerGrain, and IWorkflowProfileReferenceCoordinator expose no test-only deactivation operation, and their implementations contain no corresponding method.
AgentGrain, EpicGrain, IssueGrain, and WorkflowGrain derive identity exclusively from their authoritative Orleans grain keys and contain no GrainKeyForTest fallback.
All rehydration tests formerly forcing one grain inactive use the shared SpecTests management-grain helper; direct tests that require an Orleans key run through a real test-cluster activation.
Focused grain lifecycle, rehydration, and identity regression coverage passes, and architecture coverage prevents reintroduction of the removed test controls.
tasks.output: Production grain contracts with Orleans-owned lifecycle and identity, plus migrated server specs and architecture guards.
tasks.notes: Keep WorkflowGrain.BindProfileForTest unchanged; it is explicitly outside this change.

tasks.title: Make registered server collaborators required
tasks.description: Make audited production collaborators non-nullable wherever normal registration guarantees them: workflow profile resolution, event push, required background work, and AgentJob storage and dispatch observation. Remove unreachable null fallbacks, select EventPushQueue or NullEventPushQueue explicitly at composition, and preserve only documented non-authoritative cache and diagnostic dependencies as optional.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue, workflow-profile, and profile-reference paths require IWorkflowProfileProvider and no longer use a missing-provider legacy template fallback.
EventDispatcherService requires IEventPushQueue; every composition explicitly registers either a live queue or NullEventPushQueue, and no constructor-level null fallback remains.

Audited IBackgroundTaskLauncher, IAgentJobStore, and IAgentJobDispatchObserver consumers declare production-required collaborators explicitly; tests provide real collaborators or named fakes rather than relying on omitted dependencies.

Only genuinely optional cache and diagnostic side channels remain nullable with a local reason, while focused dependency, profile-resolution, event-dispatch, and architecture tests pass without changing external API, CLI, workflow, or persistence behavior.
tasks.output: Explicit server composition and non-null production collaborator contracts with regression coverage.
tasks.notes: Audit every current nullable occurrence before tightening it; do not make an intentionally optional side channel mandatory merely for uniformity.

tasks.title: Observe deferred AgentSession persistence in test hosts
tasks.description: Add checkpointed SpecTests persistence probes by decorating AgentSession state and transcript stores in fake and database-backed test hosts. Migrate every FlushForTestAsync caller to await the relevant recorded persistence outcome or the existing deterministic scheduler boundary, then remove the flush command from the AgentSession grain contract and implementation without changing FlushAsync production semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: The test-only probe records successful and failed state, event, and transcript writes by session and monotonic checkpoint, allowing waits to observe a write that completed before the wait began.

All former FlushForTestAsync callers await a precise persistence outcome or deterministically drive the existing scheduler; no migrated test uses polling, Task.Delay, wall-clock waits, or a forced grain flush.
IAgentSessionGrain and AgentSessionGrain expose no test-only flush command, while the production service graph contains no persistence probe or decorator registration.

Focused AgentSession persistence tests prove successful ordering, state/event-save quarantine, transcript-only retry, failed observation, and unobserved production-equivalent timer behavior; relevant server unit, spec, and architecture suites pass.
tasks.output: Checkpointed test-host AgentSession persistence observation and flush-free persistence specifications.
tasks.notes: T-001 first removes AgentSession's separate deactivation control from the shared grain contract. The probe must delegate only and never own clearing, retry, ordering, or timer decisions.
